conditions.task: enter assigned A1/A2 values and save XLSX
conditions.model: same active primary conversation; exact provider model/version and per-call usage unavailable
conditions.isolation: fresh private Xvfb/Openbox/LibreOffice profile for each arm; sequential same host, not frozen exogenous timing

deviations: At most two extra observations per unreadable transition, logged and counted. Stop on failed/unknown input or fixture failure. Never replay uncertain input. Do not regenerate failed allocation. Preserve ordinary argument errors. No duplicate-only observations.
review: Actual primary image/reference review required before next input; not an automated policy or helper model.
measures: host timing boundaries and caller review declarations
unmeasured: exact first useful visual feedback instant
scope: one engineering functional pair, fixed B0 then C1 order; not blind/independent formal benchmark or statistics
